Round 1 receiver review: traced separate admission budgets, UTC-day public cache without ingest advisory lock, IPv4-or-IPv6-/64 daily memory-salted HMAC, LRU overflow, per-value distinct contributor SQL, bucketed counters, equal public/publisher k=10, atomic capacity counter, periodic finalization/hash deletion and 90-day raw retention. Legacy joint cells are discarded by migration 3 and cannot be reconstructed as distinct-network marginals. Reviewed README, deployment and module/monitoring claims and remaining botnet, proxy/NAT, restart, multiple-process and publication-lag limits. Executed 27 focused tests with PGlite SQL, native PostgreSQL full receiver qualifier at 53ae7d63561, and five named fault injections with clean-tree red/restored-green evidence at 71a41fbb639. Synthetic dashboard browser rendering executed. No deployed sender, ingress, backup/restore or production calls.
